en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling cobblestone street lined with late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings with awnings over the shopfronts. Many well‑dressed pedestrians, men in suits and hats and women in long dresses with umbrellas, stand and stroll along the street. A young girl poses in the foreground. At the top in red letters it reads "Lobositz" and "Dr. Kubitschka-Gasse". A sign on the left building reads "Kirchen‑Gasse". The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century Central European town scene.
